description: This file contains a JUnit test class for testing the behavior of MultiMapInjectAdapter and MultiMapExtractAdapter classes within the org.eclipse.hono.tracing package. It verifies that entries injected into a MultiMap are correctly extracted, ensuring proper integration between inject and extract adapters.

classes.name: MultiMapInjectExtractAdapterTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for MultiMapInjectAdapter and MultiMapExtractAdapter, verifying injection and extraction of map entries.

methods.name: testInjectAndExtract
methods.description: Tests that entries injected via MultiMapInjectAdapter are correctly extracted via MultiMapExtractAdapter.
